basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer who recently discovered the vast world of Reddit. Originally from Tampa Bay, Florida, I spend my free time exploring new gaming strategies and diving into role-playing games. Currently working as a barista at a local coffee shop while taking classes in graphic design. I'm single and often online during late evenings and weekends, especially active in discussions about fantasy and sci-fi genres. I have a keen interest in martial arts, particularly Eskrima.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Self-taught gamer with a passion for strategy and role-playing games. Recently started learning about martial arts, specifically Eskrima, through online forums and YouTube tutorials. Currently exploring graphic design through online courses.
